'''Orsis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that had jungles, [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and at least one [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]]. It was home to the [[Orsis Academy]], which was famous for training [[tracker]]s, [[Spy/Legends|spys]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]; among its most famous graduates was a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].
